subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: While the switch-over is in effect, the system shall apply the document pipeline's checks to existing documents only and none to a draft-born feature.
rationale: The old checks only guard old documents (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-6, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-26)
fit_criterion: Draft-born fixtures trigger zero document-pipeline check findings, while edit fixtures on existing documents still trigger the existing immutability refusals.
